senses.gloss:
(I)--Earth: (भूमि, s.v.) one of the seven worlds; released from रसातल by Hari in वराह form, this, देवी worships Hari in that form in Uttara-Kuru;
1: भा. IV. १७. ३४; M. ६०. 2.
when पृथु wanted to punish her for scarce supply of food, she trembled and appealed to him to make the ground level plain and milk her with a calf and a pail; was milked by the King, sages, Gods, asuras and others; hilly tracts got levelled, and cities and villages were founded.
2: भा. IV. १७. १३-36; १८. 2-३२.
भू is said to have given योगिच् पादुकस् to पृथु.
3: Ib. IV. १५. १८.
presiding deity is Agni; [page२-571+ २९] burnt by प्रलय fire;
4: Br. II. १९. १५५; २१. २१; IV. 1. १५६; 2. 9-१९, ४१, २२३.
the measurement of the earth (Pra- माणम्) attempted by हर्यश्वस् (s.v.).
5: M. 5. 6.
